name: Devoted Vampire
source:
Rarely do residents go out at night because they fear for their lives. Police often leave this area alone due to its connections to unknown people of power. It is the perfect hunting ground for a vampire such as yourself. 

However, after seeing blood in your apartment's hallway and a cop showing sudden interest in your turf you will need to put extra effort into finding your prey. 

Keep yourself from accusations and find out who is behind all the murders within the limited daylight hours your vampire body can handle. 

[From [url=https://cheribeanart.itch.io/devoted-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
居民晚上很少外出，因为他们担心自己的生命安全。由于该地区与不知名的权力人物有联系，警方经常对这个地区置之不理。对于像你这样的吸血鬼来说，这里是完美的狩猎场。

然而，在你的公寓走廊里看到血迹并且警察突然对你的地盘表现出兴趣后，你将需要付出额外的努力来寻找你的猎物。

让自己远离指控，并在你的吸血鬼身体可以处理的有限的白天时间内找出所有谋杀案的幕后黑手。

[来自[url=https://cheribeanart.itch.io/devoted-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
